# locale's cldr-numbers-full/main/<locale>/currencies.json) and third_party/cldr-json
# (currencyData.json). Do not edit. TAB-separated lines: fraction <CODE|DEFAULT>
# digits=… [rounding=…] · currency <locale> <CODE> field=… — a field is written only where
# it differs from what the parents (those of data/numbers.txt) and CLDR's fallback give:
# narrow → symbol; name-<category> → name-other → name. Absent everywhere, symbol and
# name are the code. `\u{…}` escapes invisible characters and `\`. Format: src/currency.rs.
